title: Solutions, Slope Fields, and Euler's Method
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Direction (Slope) Field
definitions.statement: A visual geometric representation of a first-order differential equation consisting of short line segments with slope f(x, y) plotted on a grid of points (x, y) in the plane. Solution curves are tangent to these segments everywhere.
conditions: f(x, y) is defined at grid points
definitions.explanation: Allows qualitative analysis of solution behavior (asymptotes, stability, trends) without explicit algebraic solutions.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Solution curves flow through direction fields along local slope tangents.

definitions.title: Euler's Numerical Method
definitions.latex: y_{n+1} = y_n + f(x_n, y_n) \Delta x, \quad x_{n+1} = x_n + \Delta x
definitions.statement: A step-by-step numerical approximation technique for initial value problems that marches forward along tangent lines with step size Delta x.
conditions: Delta x is a small positive step size
definitions.explanation: First-order numerical method with local truncation error O((Delta x)^2) and global error O(Delta x).
